cellier.sous_titre: The household's shopping list, and the cheapest basket across the drives.
cellier.erreurs.connexion: Moli is not answering: check the connection, then try again.
cellier.erreurs.achat: This purchase no longer exists: the page was just updated.
cellier.erreurs.produit: The product “{id}” no longer exists: choose another one.
cellier.absent.titre: The pantry is not switched on
cellier.absent.texte: To start it, add a [pantry] section to moli.toml, then restart Moli.
cellier.liste.ajouter_label: Add an item to the list
cellier.liste.vide: The list is empty. Add what is missing, the agent takes care of the prices.
cellier.panier.aucun: No basket in progress. The agent proposes one as soon as it has read the prices.
cellier.panier.detail_reparti: The split basket, store by store
cellier.panier.fiches_aide: The agent found them: check it is the right product. Choosing an option confirms the ones it uses.
cellier.panier.introuvables_aide: No recent price in the drives: they are left out of the comparison.
cellier.panier.ailleurs_aide: These products come from a store outside the comparison.
cellier.panier.ecarts_aide: Tick the ones you accept before choosing an option.
cellier.panier.etape.chosen: The agent fills the drives' carts. Paying is up to you.
cellier.panier.etape.filled: The carts are filled: payment is left to do on the drive's site.
cellier.panier.etape.ordered: Ordered: the groceries are left to pick up.
cellier.panier.abandonner_confirmer: Drop this basket? The items stay on the list.
cellier.produits.aucun: No product yet. The agent creates them when it looks for prices.
cellier.produits.aucune_fiche: No sheet in any store yet.
cellier.reglages.seuil: Threshold to split between two drives
cellier.reglages.seuil_aide: The split basket is only recommended when it costs at least {pct} % less than the best single drive.
cellier.ticket.illisible: I cannot read this receipt: take the photo again, flat and well lit.
cellier.ticket.pas_assistant: No assistant is set up to read receipts.
cellier.ticket.refuse: Reading receipts is not allowed with this assistant (see the assistant settings).
cellier.ticket.lecture_inutilisable: The reading of the receipt gave no usable result: try again.
cellier.ticket.photos_refusees: The photos were refused: 1 to 4 JPEG images are expected.
cellier.achats.a_valider_aide: Receipts read, not yet recorded: check them, then validate.
cellier.achats.aucun: No purchases over the last 12 months. Scan a receipt after shopping: its lines land here.
cellier.achats.supprimer_confirmer: Delete this purchase ({nom})? It will no longer count in the spending.
cellier.achats.quantite_invalide: The quantity must be a number above zero.
cellier.achats.prix_invalide: The price must be an amount, for instance 2.58.
cellier.scan.aide: Take the whole receipt, flat and well lit. A long receipt takes several photos, from top to bottom (4 at most).
cellier.scan.suite: Add the rest of the receipt
cellier.scan.trop: A receipt fits in {max} photos at most: the extra ones were left out.
cellier.scan.attente: Reading takes up to 30 seconds ({s} s).
cellier.ticket.photo_illisible: This photo cannot be opened here (unsupported format): take it again, or pick it as a JPEG.
cellier.ticket.occupe: Moli is busy, try again in a moment.
cellier.ticket.trop_lourd: The photos are too heavy: remove one, or take them again.
cellier.ticket.demande_refusee: The assistant did not accept these photos: take them again, then retry.
cellier.ticket.doublon: This receipt looks recorded already on {date}.
cellier.ticket.doublon_confirmer: This receipt looks recorded already. Record it anyway?
cellier.ticket.manque: {montant} is missing: a line may have been misread.
cellier.ticket.depasse: The lines exceed the total by {montant}: a line may have been misread.
cellier.ticket.drive_double: A drive order of the same day looks counted already ({date}, {montant}): this receipt would count it twice.
cellier.ticket.date_future: The date is in the future: check it, or this receipt will not show in the purchases.
cellier.ticket.date_ancienne: The date is over 12 months old: check it, or this receipt will not show in the purchases.
cellier.ticket.parti: This receipt was validated or abandoned in the meantime.
cellier.ticket.introuvable: This receipt no longer exists: it was probably abandoned.
cellier.ticket.deja_valide: This receipt is validated already: its lines are in the purchases.
cellier.ticket.lignes_aide: What lasts (furniture, decoration, toys…) does not belong in the Pantry: untick it. Each kept line needs a product.
cellier.ticket.probleme.name: Give the new product a name.
cellier.ticket.probleme.qty: The quantity must be above zero.
cellier.ticket.probleme.price: The price and the discount cannot be negative.
cellier.ticket.aucune_ligne_confirmer: No line is ticked: the receipt will be recorded without any purchase. Validate anyway?
cellier.ticket.liste_aide: Tick what this receipt bought: these items leave the list on validation.
cellier.ticket.abandonner_confirmer: Abandon this receipt? The draft and its photos will be deleted.
cellier.produits.aucun_achat: Not bought over the last 12 months.
cellier.reglages.photos_partent: On your Moli server, they are erased 90 days after the receipt is validated; the reading service applies its own retention policy.
cellier.reglages.lecteur_refuse: Receipts cannot be read for now.
cellier.ticket.connexion_lecture: Connection lost during the reading, try again.
cellier.ticket.quitter_confirmer: The corrections of this receipt are not saved. Leave anyway?
cellier.code.requis: To send a receipt to Moli, tell it it is you: type your code.
